quote.text: Two characteristics shared by gods and men (and every rational creature): i. Not to let others hold you back. ii. To locate goodness in thinking and doing the right thing, and to limit your desires to that. 35.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood: Encourage your children to develop independence—teach them not to be held back by external doubts and pressures.
  • Parenthood: Instill the value of ethical behavior by guiding them to recognize that true goodness lies in thoughtful actions and limiting unnecessary desires.
  • Leadership: Embrace a leadership style that empowers every team member, ensuring that neither you nor your colleagues allow obstacles to stifle growth.
  • Leadership: Lead by example by constantly striving to do what is morally right and encouraging your team to pursue excellence beyond mere ambition.
  • Product Management: Cultivate a work culture that values meaningful and ethical innovation, reminding your team that success arises from focusing on the right ideas rather than unbridled desires.
  • Product Management: Apply these principles to product strategy—empower creative thinking and measured progress, ensuring that every decision aligns with both rational goals and moral clarity.
